note: PLUGIN-009 constrain plugin authority: src/plugin/authority.zig grants only what a manifest declares, and declares narrowly on purpose - a grant names a path and a set of modes, so a read declaration is not write access and covered-by-path with an ungranted mode is refused with the mode named, which tells the caller it needs a declaration rather than a different path. Containment is decided on normalized paths, so src/../../secrets is not inside src, and component-boundary matching keeps a prefix-sharing sibling out. Wildcard declarations are refused at evaluation so an allow-everything manifest cannot be written at all, and the decision names its basis, because a decision that cannot name its basis is not auditable. The test covers granted path and mode, an undeclared path, a mode mismatch, two escaping paths, an undeclared credential, two wildcard manifests, a prefix sibling, and an empty manifest. Fault proof: treating a declared read mode as granting every mode makes the write request succeed and the mode assertion fails (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
